parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma and Jimmy are discussing trades. Jimmy just rejected her offer of Wood for Wheat, claiming he has enough Wood and his Wheat is too precious because I blocked his 9-Wheat hex. This is good for me; their alliance is shaky if they can't agree on resources. Gemma mentioned I'm trying to block the board, which is true but I should stay quiet while they bicker.
